title: Presets
html:
Searched with tools/rotopt -template warrior_tank -tank <preset> on the six scoring encounters (their mean), the synthetic Level 60 set, 600 iterations a candidate and 3,000 to confirm (Max survival 2,000 and 6,000: its paired noise is about three times Balanced's). Talent and knob searches alternated until neither moved. The raw output is in orchestration/tank_handoff/warrior/ (ts_*, knobs_*, races_*).

Balanced's knobs: shieldBlock=1 (whenever its buff is down), sbRage=0, demo=0, tc=1, tcRefresh=2, debuffsFirst=0, revengeFirst=0, sunderUp=1, sunderRage=30, hsRage=50, bloodrageRage=30, opener=0, chargeFrom=0, potion=1, shieldWall=2 (the last 12 s), wallAt=12, trinketAt=0, recklessSwingsRage=0, slamRage=0. Max survival's APL is Balanced's (same talents and knobs); it gets its own file so the UI keeps three.

Undead's lead at every weight is Touch of the Grave's drain healing the tank, modelled at its "up to 5% of max health" cap (sim/core/racials_forever.go): a call (below). Without it, Tauren leads at Balanced and Max survival, and the Skyborne and Tauren tie at Max threat.

What the searches dropped: Slam (15 s under Forever) at every weight (-150 to -380), Reckless Swings (no searched build keeps it: a 16-point Fury start traded it for Deflection), Demoralizing Shout (the tank pays for it, tankscore.OwnDebuffs), Vanguard and the Charge opener (Charge from Defensive Stance needs Vanguard; opener=0 scores the same as the old Bloodrage-and-Charge opener), Last Stand (its health change isn't followed by the replay, see Rotation template), Gore Drinker (unreachable with Shield Slam).

Files: tools/tankbench/req/warrior_protection_{max_threat,balanced,max_survival}.json, ui/tank_warrior/apls/level60_{max_threat,balanced,max_survival}.apl.json, ui/tank_warrior/presets.ts (the three builds, Balanced first). tools/tankbench/req/warrior_protection.json is left as it was (35--251533120331221351, Orc, its old gear): sim/raid_healing_test.go, tools/healbench, tools/encounters/from_logs.py and TestForeverTankScore read it, and replacing it breaks TestForeverTankScore (no iteration needs 500 HPS on the synthetic set) and TestHealingFightHealComm. Whether the healing tools move to the Balanced request is the orchestrator's to decide with the healing session.

title: Touch of the Grave's drain
html: Touch of the Grave's drain (Undead): modelled at its "up to 5% of max health" cap, which makes Undead the best race at every weight (+115 Balanced, +106 Max threat, +116 Max survival over the next race). Default: Undead. At a lower drain the presets would take Tauren (Balanced 3,680.6, Max survival 1,368.9; Max threat the Skyborne 4,603.1).

title: Shield Slam's threat
html: Shield Slam's threat (flat 508 on top of damage): the client says "very high threat" with no number. Default the sim's 508 (Rules audit, Shield Slam row).

title: Revenge's attack power ratio
html: Revenge's attack power ratio: the tooltip reads 22.5% since 70707; the sim keeps 28% (T2, a log fit of 0.277 ± 0.009).

title: Thunder Clap's threat
html: Thunder Clap's threat (2.5 × damage): T3 (Classic); wowsims/forever leaves it at 1× unmeasured. Max threat drops Thunder Clap (tc=0) either way; Balanced keeps it up.

title: Max survival is Balanced's build
html: Max survival is Balanced's build: no knob or talent of the template moves it past its noise. Its real levers react to health (Last Stand, Shield Wall on low health), which the score can't see (brief step 2): they're in the UI for the player, not in the presets. The alternative, a Shield Wall timer, is in the template (shieldWall=2, the last 12 s).

title: Presets

Everything below is on the merged code (the healer merge and claude/clever-galileo-qim1ee, 2026-11-04); the pre-merge bests re-evaluated at 3,000 within 10 of their old scores (Human Balanced 2432.0 to 2422.5, Undead 2544.2 to 2543.7).

Why Undead leads, per encounter (Balanced, 3,000 iterations, Human / Dwarf / Undead): Magmadar 2867 / 2844 / 3000, Golemagg 2643 / 2617 / 2764, Onyxia 2931 / 2924 / 3093, Broodlord 1817 / 1802 / 1889, Vaelastrasz 2812 / 2793 / 2935, Chromaggus 1467 / 1446 / 1582. It leads on every encounter by about the same, fear or no fear, so it is not Will of the Forsaken (the scoring fights leave Panic and Bellowing Roar out anyway). It is Forever's Touch of the Grave (sim/core/racials_forever.go): every ability rolls 20% to drain up to 5% of max health, at most once every 15 sec, as Shadow damage that heals the tank. Against Human it is +26 to +47 SafeDPS a fight (the drain's damage at Righteous Fury's threat) and 3 to 23 less healing needed. The drain is modelled at its cap ("up to" isn't published), so this is the racial's upper bound: a call (below). Undead's 10 Shadow resistance and its base stats (below Human's but for Spirit) don't explain it. Night Elf is second, a tie at Max threat (3.1 apart, paired noise about 1.7).

  • The UI: ui/protection_paladin/presets.ts and sim.ts carry the synthetic gear (GearLevel60Synthetic), the three APLs, the two talent strings and three builds (makePresetBuild with the race, the professions and {primarySeal: Fury, righteousFury: true, aura: DevotionAura}), Balanced first. The page's defaults (its launch state) are as they were. npx tsc --noEmit -p . is clean for ui/protection_paladin.
  • paladin_protection_valor.json (the old Valor bench request) is removed; nothing read it. TestForeverProtTankScore reads the new Balanced request and passes as it is.

title: Seal of Fury's effect 0 and Judgement of Fury's effect 2
html: Seal of Fury's effect 0 and Judgement of Fury's effect 2. The client gives both a dummy effect of 1607 + 42 a level with 9% / 18% of spell power, and no tooltip says what it does. Default: not read (the seal's 35 Holy a hit, its absorb and the Judgement's damage are what the tooltips name, and what wowsims/forever models). Not measured: no source says whether it is damage, an absorb cap or a server-side script, so there is nothing to model. If it is damage it would be the seal's largest part; an in-game log of a Judgement of Fury would settle it.

title: The immunities out of scoring
html: The immunities out of scoring. Divine Shield, Divine Protection and Lay on Hands are built, tested and in the UI, but no preset casts them: an immune or pacified tank keeps no threat and the boss turns to someone else, which the tank score doesn't model (it has one tank), and Lay on Hands reacts to health. Default: out. Templar's Bulwark stays in on a timer (bulwarkAt=10, worth 280 to 320 at Balanced), and it shares Forbearance with them, so casting either would cost it.

title: Pursuit of Justice
html: Pursuit of Justice (movement speed). Default: not taken; the score has no movement, so it is worth 0 in every preset. A call only if movement matters on a fight the bench doesn't model.

title: Hit to the cap out of Stamina and Strength
html: Hit to the cap out of Stamina and Strength. The restart brief sized the synthetic set's hit to the 8% cap counting Precision (standards 4), paid for out of the row's Stamina and Strength. Default: the cap, +29 at Balanced over the gear row's 3.2% (2026-11-04, the realignment's measurement). The alternative is the row as written: 29 lower, more Stamina, less threat.

title: Templar's Bulwark is Magic
html: Templar's Bulwark is Magic (dispellable). The client carries it since 70753 (SpellCategories DispelType 1 on 1311015; round 70753's paladin.md and foreverchanges.pro list it as notes-only). Default: as the client says, and it moves nothing: no scoring boss dispels, and the sim's auras have no dispel type to set. The round file's note could be corrected to "client and notes".

title: Undead over Human and Dwarf
html: Undead over Human and Dwarf. Undead leads at every weight, through Touch of the Grave modelled at its cap (5% of max health every 15 sec at the most, "up to" with no published amount; Presets, above). Default: Undead (+121 over Human at Balanced, +140 over Dwarf, +19 over Night Elf; +86 / +105 / +3 at Max threat; +233 / +251 / +60 at Max survival). If the drain is well under its cap the lead shrinks, and Night Elf (at Max survival perhaps Tauren's 5% health) may be the pick: Undead's base stats are below Human's but for Spirit. Not measured with a smaller drain (it needs a sim change to the shared racial). An in-game log of the drain's amount would settle it.

title: Presets
html:
Three presets, all Night Elf on the synthetic set above with one talent build, -5022233202310212551-055. Each was found by a talent search and then a knob search (tools/rotopt -template druid_tank -tank <w>) on the six scoring encounters (Magmadar, Golemagg, Onyxia, Broodlord, Vaelastrasz, Chromaggus): 600 iterations a candidate, confirmed at 3,000, then a race check at 3,000. The requests are tools/tankbench/req/druid_bear_{max_threat,balanced,max_survival}.json (druid_bear_balanced.json replaces druid_bear.json, and sim/druid/tank/tank_test.go reads it). The APLs are ui/feral_tank_druid/apls/*.apl.json, and presets.ts builds them.

  • Talents. Every weight moved Furor's 5 points out: to Shredding Attacks 3 and Brutal Impact 2 (+19 at Balanced over the old build at 3,000 iterations; Furor 0 is +13.6 over Furor 2). With the prepull shift done 1.5 sec early, Furor's 10 Rage a shift is worth nothing, and at Max survival a point scores -0.6. Feral Instinct (Swipe, never cast) and Brutal Impact (no Bash in the rotation) are dead points kept only because the tier needs them. Lacerate, Primal Bite, Rend and Tear 5, Natural Reaction 5, Blood Frenzy 2, Thick Hide 3 and Predatory Strikes 3 all stay at every weight.
  • Balanced (w=1): the knobs didn't move from the earlier search. Demoralizing Roar refreshed under 3 sec, Primal Bite on cooldown, Lacerate to 5 stacks and then the filler, refreshed under 4 sec, Maul at 30 Rage, Enrage at the pull and 1 sec before it, a shift 1.5 sec before the pull, and Barkskin as the filler. What each costs taken out: Barkskin -159, the prepull shift -62, Enrage -24, Maul at 40 Rage -11, at 80 -144 (25 to 30 is flat). The Swipe threshold has no effect, since Lacerate fills every GCD. Frenzied Regeneration at 100 Rage is -3.
  • Max threat (w=1/3): Balanced with Maul at 20 Rage (2,910.6 at 3,000 iterations, against about 2,903).
  • Max survival (w=3): Balanced with Frenzied Regeneration at 100 Rage and Enrage 3 sec before the pull, so its armor cut ends sooner (-857.1 against -1,250.9 at 3,000 iterations).
  • Race. Night Elf is best at every weight (six-encounter mean, 3,000 iterations):

title: Threat from mana gains
html: Threat from mana gains. The engine counts the mana that Judgement of Wisdom gives back as threat (about 8 TPS here), which is most of why the prepull shift pays. That is an engine rule for every tank, so not mine to change. Default: as it is.

html: Furor scores nothing for a bear that shifts before the pull, so the presets drop it. Default: Furor 0.

html:
Three presets on the six scoring encounters (Magmadar, Golemagg, Onyxia, Broodlord, Vaelastrasz, Chromaggus), by the tank objective at w = 1/3, 1 and 3 (docs/tank_sim.md): tools/tankbench/req/shaman_warden_<preset>.json, ui/warden_shaman/apls/level60_<preset>.apl.json, the synthetic set (gear_sets/phase1_synthetic_tank.gear.json, and phase1_synthetic_tank_armor_trinket.gear.json for Max survival) and three builds in presets.ts. Talents. Candidate builds scored at Balanced (1,500 iterations) put the realigned Level 60 build at -472 (+/- 1,392: its Broodlord death floor sits at 4.3%, next to the 5% line) and build B at 495 (+/- 23). B moves 10 points out of Convection 3, Elemental Focus, a point of Elemental Warding, Guardian Totems 2, a point of Improved Lightning Shield and 2 of Elemental Weapons into Restoration's Tidal Focus 5 (5% melee and spell hit, cheaper heals) and Improved Reincarnation 2 (4% health), plus Mental Quickness 2 and Rage of the Farseer. The 4% health is what Broodlord wants (floor 4.3% to 0.7%). Talent searches from B (rotopt -talent-search -require spiritWeapons, 600 to 1,000 iterations a candidate, 3,000 to confirm):

  • Balanced: no move past the paired noise (best +20 +/- 34), so B stays.
  • Max survival: only mana tie-breaks (-5,460 against B's -5,409 at 3,000), so B stays.
  • Max threat: Elemental Weapons 3 for Shamanistic Focus and a point of Elemental Warding, 2,526 against B's 2,482 at 3,000 (+44, noise 12). The same build at Balanced is a tie (466 against 463) with half the time to out of mana (113 s against 206 s), and at Max survival worse (-5,533 against -5,409), so it stays Max threat's.

Knobs (600 iterations, 3,000 to confirm): the template's defaults are best at Balanced and Max survival (Stoneskin, Lightning Shield, Earth Shock on cooldown, no fire or water totem, no self heal); at Max threat Mana Spring Totem (+8). No Healing Stream Totem or health-blind Lesser Healing Wave won at any weight.

Races (build B, 1,000 iterations, Max threat / Balanced / Max survival): Tauren 2,501 / 515 / -5,312 (600 iterations, Max survival with the armor trinket); Orc 2,441 / 123 / -6,830; Troll 2,423 / 117 / -6,802; Dwarf 2,342 / 10 / -6,987; Skyborne Windshaper 2,325 / -76 / -7,279 (the High Order has the same base stats). Tauren's 5% health keeps Broodlord's death floor lowest; with B's 4% health the other races are past 5% no longer, but well behind. Tauren at every weight.

Hit (B, 3,000 iterations): the set's 5.5% gear hit plus Tidal Focus is 10.5%, over the 8% melee cap; gear hit counts for spells in Forever (unifyEquipHitAndCrit), so it still helps Earth Shock. Moving the hit over 8% to crit (budget neutral) loses at every weight: Max threat 2,392 against 2,476, Balanced 359 against 463, Max survival -5,738 against -5,575. The set keeps the row's hit (standards 4: the mix that sims best).

On-use trinket (B, 3,000 iterations): the armor one (999216) against the attack power one (990015): Max threat 2,395 against 2,476, Balanced 444 against 463, Max survival -5,409 against -5,575. So Max survival wears the armor trinket and the other two the attack power one.

What the update moved (Balanced, the mean of the six, 1,000 iterations): -1,170 before it (commit f9cc1ecaf, the 0.7 reference member; Broodlord -10,482 at a 4.5% death floor), -618 after the remap on the same build (TPS 1,066 to 1,416 from Earth Shock's base and Stormstrike's 6 s; SafeDPS about 110 lower from the 1.0 reference member), 501 with the Balanced preset.

The Warden takes the most damage (above) but has the most SafeDPS: its threat comes at the pull (Earth Shock at twice its damage with a full mana bar, Stormstrike, the prepull totems), so the reference member's worst moment, which comes in the first seconds, is better than the warrior's, whose rage starts at zero (SafeDPS 1.10 x TPS against the warrior's 0.84). That lead rests on Earth Shock's threat multiplier (call (a)).

title: Open questions
html:
• (a) Earth Shock's threat multiplier. Default 2 (Classic's, vmangos; the tooltip says "causes a high amount of threat"; no Forever source gives a number). wowsims/forever uses 1. Measured on the Balanced preset (1,000 iterations, means of the six): at 1, TPS 1,589 to 1,399, SafeDPS 1,745 to 1,526, scores 2,493 / 501 / -5,475 to 2,056 / 63 / -5,913. A /combatlog threat check in game would settle it.
  • (b) The defensive on-use trinket. Default: the synthetic 1,665 armor for 20 s every 2 min (999216) in Max survival, as the defensive counterpart of the Enhancement set's attack power trinket at the same item level. The alternative, the attack power trinket everywhere, costs Max survival 166 (-5,575 against -5,409).
  • (c) The class gap. The Warden needs about 11% more healing than the warrior (1,055 against 947), from its missing plate, active block and damage reduction (above). Default: leave it, it's the class as the client and the notes have it. Nothing in the sim to change unless Forever adds a mitigation talent.
  • (d) Hit above the melee cap. Default: the set keeps the row's 5.5% gear hit (10.5% with Tidal Focus), since gear hit counts for spells in Forever. Moving the hit past 8% into crit loses 104 at Balanced (above).
